title: ME60353: Knowledge Based Systems In Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to expert systems – Definition, Need for expert systems, Methods
of developing expert system – offline training/learning & on-line
training/learning
Tools for developing expert systems – Hard Computing vs. Soft Computing, Fuzzy
Set Theory, Fuzzy Logic Controllers (FLC), Neural Network (NN) Controllers –
back propagation network, SOM, radial basis function networks, recurrent neural
networks etc., Learning/optimisation tools – traditional (direct search and
gradient based) and non-traditional (genetic algorithms (GAs), simulated
annealing etc.) techniques. Combined techniques of soft computing – GA-FLC, GANN, NN-FLC, GA-FLC-NN
Some Applications

Concepts taught in class

Student Opinion
Contents of these playlists - 1 and 2 is taught in the classes. Watching those videos at 2X will be enough preparation for exam. Just make sure not to make calculation mistakes in exam. This is a good course to take. Less Load. Easy grade scoring. Grading is absolute, just take care of that.
